Factory/manufacturing shed buyers — sibling MCAT 'Prefabricated Factory Shed' (ID 136750) and 'Industrial Sheds' (ID 30719) carve out factory and general industrial shed buyers; names that primarily signal factory shed or generic industrial shed (without warehouse/storage context) are excluded
Poultry and cattle shed buyers — sibling MCATs 'Poultry Sheds' (ID 145222) and 'Cattle Sheds' (ID 146519) serve agricultural livestock buyers; any name evoking farm animal housing is excluded
